import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings
import os
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct paths
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Display data shapes
print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Target classes: {train['Cover_Type'].unique()}")

# Identify target
target = "Cover_Type"

# Save test Ids before any preprocessing
test_ids = test["Id"].copy()

# Separate features and target from training data
X_full_train = train.drop([target, "Id"], axis=1)
y_train = train[target]

# Check for categorical columns
categorical_cols = X_full_train.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()
print(f"Categorical columns: {categorical_cols}")

# If there are categorical columns, encode them
if categorical_cols:
    X_full_train = pd.get_dummies(
        X_full_train, columns=categorical_cols, drop_first=True
    )
    test = pd.get_dummies(test, columns=categorical_cols, drop_first=True)

# Ensure consistent column order - only for feature columns
X_full_train = X_full_train[X_full_train.columns.intersection(test.columns)]
test = test[test.columns.intersection(X_full_train.columns)]

print(f"Final feature shape: {X_full_train.shape}")

# Hold out validation set from training data (model will never see this)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_full_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42
)
print(f"Train validation shape: {X_train.shape}, {y_train.shape}")
print(f"Validation shape: {X_val.shape}, {y_val.shape}")

# Train ensemble of Random Forest models with increased n_estimators (300 instead of 100)
n_models = 5
predictions_val = np.zeros((len(X_val), n_models), dtype=int)
predictions_test = np.zeros((len(test), n_models), dtype=int)

print("\nStarting training with 5 Random Forest models (300 trees each)...")
start_time = time.time()

for i in range(n_models):
    model = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=30,
        min_samples_split=5,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        random_state=2021 + i * 100,
        n_jobs=-1,
        verbose=False,
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Get predictions on validation set
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    predictions_val[:, i] = y_pred_val

    # Get predictions on test set
    y_pred_test = model.predict(test)
    predictions_test[:, i] = y_pred_test

    val_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val)
    print(f"Model {i+1}/5 validation accuracy: {val_acc:.6f}")

end_time = time.time()
print(f"\nTraining completed in {end_time - start_time:.0f} seconds")

# Majority voting on validation set to get final predictions
final_val_predictions = []
for i in range(len(y_val)):
    counts = np.bincount(predictions_val[i])
    final_val_predictions.append(counts.argmax())
final_val_predictions = np.array(final_val_predictions)

# Compute final validation accuracy
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, final_val_predictions)
print(f"\nEnsemble hold-out validation accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.6f}")

# Create final submission using majority voting on test predictions
final_test_predictions = []
for i in range(len(test)):
    counts = np.bincount(predictions_test[i])
    final_test_predictions.append(counts.argmax())
final_test_predictions = np.array(final_test_predictions)

# Create submission file with correct format - restore Id column
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": final_test_predictions})

# Save to the required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Unique Cover_Type values in submission: {submission['Cover_Type'].unique()}")
